title: LSTM 门控公式数值演算
code:
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(1)
def sigmoid(x): return 1.0/(1.0+np.exp(-x))
H = 4
W = {k: np.random.randn(H, 2*H)*0.5 for k in ['f','i','o','c']}
b = {k: np.zeros(H) for k in ['f','i','o','c']}
h_prev = np.zeros(H)
c_prev = np.zeros(H)
x = np.random.randn(H)
cat = np.concatenate([h_prev, x])
f = sigmoid(W['f'] @ cat + b['f'])
i = sigmoid(W['i'] @ cat + b['i'])
o = sigmoid(W['o'] @ cat + b['o'])
g = np.tanh(W['c'] @ cat + b['c'])
c = f * c_prev + i * g
h = o * np.tanh(c)
print("隐藏维度 H =", H)
print("遗忘门 f (sigmoid, 应∈(0,1)):", np.round(f,3))
print("输入门 i (sigmoid, 应∈(0,1)):", np.round(i,3))
print("输出门 o (sigmoid, 应∈(0,1)):", np.round(o,3))
print("候选 g (tanh,   应∈(-1,1)):", np.round(g,3))
print("细胞态 c = f*c_prev + i*g:", np.round(c,3))
print("隐藏态 h = o*tanh(c):", np.round(h,3))
print("验证: 所有门均落在正确区间 ->",
      bool(f.max()<1 and f.min()>0 and i.max()<1 and c.shape==(H,)))
